sentences.text: HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  CONT No. 282 of 2020  Sarika Singh W/o Anil Singh Aged About 43 Years R/o Bhatgaon  Colliery District Surajpur, Chhattisgarh.
---- Petitioner  Versus  Dr. Sanjay Kumar Alung, Collector, Bilaspur, District Bilaspur  Chhattisgarh.
---- Respondent For petitioner - Shri Amit Kumar, Advocate.

For respondent - Shri Chandresh Shrivastava,
Advocate.
Hon'ble Shri Justice Goutam Bhaduri Order 20/01/2023 1.

The Court by its order dated 13/08/2019 has ordered that the land of the petitioner be measured and if it is found that it has been used without the acquisition, the acquisition proceeding be drawn.
2.

Learned counsel for the respondent would submit that the case of the petitioner has been decided and the land for which the compensation is sought for, the compensation has already been deposited with the concerned authority and since there is a dispute in between the parties about the sharing of the compensation, it has been referred under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation &
Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act,
2013).
3. In view of such order, which is filed as Annexure R/1, contempt is purged, rule is discharged.
